title: Lost Mary BM600 Marybull Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Marybull Ice Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods offer a sports drink-inspired flavour with a fruity chill. A mix of sweet and tangy fruits provides a lively base, finished with an icy note for a light and refreshing vape. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs per pod depending on use. With a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, they’re an easy and dependable option with no refilling or coil changes needed. Compatible with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods are quick to install: click one into the device and enjoy a fruity, ice-topped flavour.
